title: dsh cordis loader patch
description: A top-level YAML array of dsh/cordis loader patch entries (id-targeted config overrides, disables, and insert lists). NOT RFC 6902 JSON Patch. See cordis-plugin-include applyEntryPatches().

id.description: Row id, unique within the composed entry list.

name.description: Plugin package name (must match the targeted row's name).

config.description: Plugin config object, or an array of child rows when group: true.

id.description: Target row id (required for non-insert patches).

name.description: Expected plugin name of the target row; mismatch skips the patch.

insert.description: Rows to append: into the group identified by id, or at top level when id is absent.

config.description: Replacement config for the target row (replaces the whole config).
